terms.en: One of Caraka's fifty mahākaṣāyas (groups of ten drugs, CS.sutra.4). Drugs that support conception and maintain pregnancy, e.g. aindrī, brāhmī, śatavīryā and sahasravīryā (varieties of dūrvā).
terms.hi: चरक के पचास महाकषायों में एक। प्रजास्थापन - गर्भ को स्थापित करने वाले।

terms.en: Root drug named for its horse-like smell; uṣṇa vīrya; balya, rasāyana, vājīkaraṇa and nidrājanana (sleep-promoting); pacifies vāta and kapha. Used for debility, emaciation and vāta disorders.
terms.hi: अश्वगन्धा - घोड़े जैसी गन्ध वाली जड़; उष्ण वीर्य; बल्य, रसायन, वाजीकरण, निद्राजनक; वात-कफशामक।
terms.modern: Withania somnifera (L.) Dunal, Solanaceae (root).

terms.en: 'Having a hundred roots'; madhura-tikta, guru-snigdha, śīta vīrya, madhura vipāka; rasāyana, stanyajanana, śukrala, pacifies vāta and pitta. Widely used in women's health.
terms.hi: शतावरी - 'सौ जड़ों वाली'; मधुर-तिक्त, शीत वीर्य; रसायन, स्तन्यजनन, शुक्रल; वात-पित्तशामक।
terms.modern: Asparagus racemosus Willd., Asparagaceae (tuberous root).

terms.en: Climbing stem drug, also called amṛtā ('nectar'); tikta-kaṣāya, uṣṇa vīrya, madhura vipāka; tridoṣa-śāmaka, rasāyana, jvaraghna, medhya (its juice is one of Caraka's medhya rasāyanas); the classic example of a saṃśamana drug.
terms.hi: गुडूची (गिलोय, अमृता) - तिक्त-कषाय, उष्ण वीर्य, मधुर विपाक; त्रिदोषशामक, रसायन, ज्वरघ्न; संशमन का उदाहरण।
terms.modern: Tinospora cordifolia (Willd.) Miers, Menispermaceae (stem).

terms.en: Fruit with five rasas (all except lavaṇa), amla predominant; śīta vīrya, madhura vipāka; tridoṣahara (especially pitta), the best vayaḥsthāpana and rasāyana; one of the triphalā. Also called dhātrī ('nurse').
terms.hi: आमलकी (आँवला, धात्री) - लवण छोड़ पाँच रस, अम्ल प्रधान; शीत वीर्य, मधुर विपाक; त्रिदोषहर, श्रेष्ठ रसायन; त्रिफला का अंग।
terms.modern: Phyllanthus emblica L. (syn. Emblica officinalis Gaertn.), Phyllanthaceae (fruit); rich in ascorbic acid and tannins.

terms.en: Fruit with five rasas (all except lavaṇa), kaṣāya predominant; uṣṇa vīrya, madhura vipāka; tridoṣahara, anulomana, rasāyana; also called abhayā and pathyā. Seven varieties (vijayā, rohiṇī, pūtanā, amṛtā, abhayā, jīvantī, cetakī) are described in later texts.
terms.hi: हरीतकी (हरड़, अभया, पथ्या) - लवण छोड़ पाँच रस, कषाय प्रधान; उष्ण वीर्य, मधुर विपाक; त्रिदोषहर, अनुलोमन, रसायन।
terms.modern: Terminalia chebula Retz., Combretaceae (fruit).

terms.en: Fruit, kaṣāya rasa, rūkṣa, uṣṇa vīrya, madhura vipāka; pacifies kapha and pitta, good for eyes, voice and hair; one of the triphalā. Its seed kernel is mildly intoxicating.
terms.hi: बिभीतकी (बहेड़ा) - कषाय, रूक्ष, उष्ण वीर्य; कफ-पित्तहर, नेत्र-स्वर-केश हितकर; त्रिफला का अंग।
terms.modern: Terminalia bellirica (Gaertn.) Roxb., Combretaceae (fruit).

terms.en: The 'three fruits': harītakī, bibhītakī and āmalakī (usually in equal parts). Tridoṣa-balancing, mild laxative, cakṣuṣya (good for eyes) and rasāyana.
terms.hi: त्रिफला - हरीतकी, बिभीतकी, आमलकी (समभाग); त्रिदोषशामक, मृदु विरेचक, चक्षुष्य, रसायन।
terms.modern: Polyherbal combination of three Terminalia/Phyllanthus fruits.

terms.en: Long pepper fruit; kaṭu rasa, madhura vipāka, vīrya described as not very hot (anuṣṇa); dīpana, kāsa-śvāsahara, rasāyana (vardhamāna pippalī rasāyana). Its root (pippalīmūla) is also used.
terms.hi: पिप्पली - कटु रस, मधुर विपाक, अनुष्णशीत; दीपन, कास-श्वासहर, रसायन (वर्धमान पिप्पली)।
terms.modern: Piper longum L., Piperaceae (fruit); contains piperine.

terms.en: Black pepper; kaṭu rasa, laghu, tīkṣṇa, uṣṇa vīrya, kaṭu vipāka; dīpana, chedana, pramāthī, kaphahara, krimighna.
terms.hi: मरिच (काली मिर्च) - कटु, तीक्ष्ण, उष्ण वीर्य; दीपन, छेदन, कफहर।
terms.modern: Piper nigrum L., Piperaceae (fruit).

terms.en: Dried ginger rhizome; kaṭu rasa, uṣṇa vīrya, madhura vipāka; dīpana, pācana, grāhī, vātakaphahara; called mahauṣadha and viśvabheṣaja ('universal medicine'). Fresh ginger is ārdraka.
terms.hi: शुण्ठी (सोंठ) - कटु, उष्ण वीर्य, मधुर विपाक; दीपन, पाचन, ग्राही; महौषध, विश्वभेषज।
terms.modern: Zingiber officinale Roscoe, Zingiberaceae (dried rhizome).

terms.en: Fresh ginger; kaṭu, uṣṇa; dīpana, bhedana; taking it with rock salt before meals is advised to improve appetite and cleanse throat and tongue.
terms.hi: आर्द्रक (अदरक) - कटु, उष्ण; दीपन; भोजन से पहले सैन्धव के साथ लेना हितकर।
terms.modern: Zingiber officinale Roscoe (fresh rhizome).

terms.en: The 'three pungents': śuṇṭhī, marica and pippalī in equal parts; dīpana, pācana, kaphahara, used for āma, obesity and respiratory disorders.
terms.hi: त्रिकटु - शुण्ठी, मरिच, पिप्पली (समभाग); दीपन, पाचन, कफहर।
terms.modern: Combination of ginger, black pepper and long pepper; piperine enhances absorption of some drugs.

terms.en: Rhizome; tikta-kaṭu, rūkṣa, uṣṇa vīrya, kaṭu vipāka; kuṣṭhaghna, pramehaghna, varṇya, viṣaghna, vraṇaropaṇa. Caraka names haridrā in several mahākaṣāyas.
terms.hi: हरिद्रा (हल्दी) - तिक्त-कटु, रूक्ष, उष्ण वीर्य; कुष्ठघ्न, प्रमेहघ्न, वर्ण्य, विषघ्न।
terms.modern: Curcuma longa L., Zingiberaceae (rhizome); curcuminoids are its main studied constituents.

terms.en: 'Wood turmeric'; tikta-kaṣāya, uṣṇa; used in eye, skin and liver disorders, prameha and wounds. Its aqueous extract is rasāñjana.
terms.hi: दारुहरिद्रा - तिक्त-कषाय, उष्ण; नेत्र, त्वचा, प्रमेह, व्रण में; इसका घन सत्त्व रसाञ्जन।
terms.modern: Berberis aristata DC., Berberidaceae (stem/root); contains berberine.

terms.en: Tikta-kaṣāya, laghu, śīta vīrya, kaṭu vipāka; kuṣṭhaghna, kaṇḍūghna, krimighna, jvaraghna, pacifies pitta and kapha; leaves, bark and oil are used.
terms.hi: निम्ब (नीम) - तिक्त-कषाय, शीत वीर्य; कुष्ठघ्न, कण्डूघ्न, कृमिघ्न, ज्वरघ्न; कफ-पित्तशामक।
terms.modern: Azadirachta indica A. Juss., Meliaceae.

terms.en: Kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; kāsa-śvāsahara, krimighna, jvaraghna, pacifies kapha and vāta; also called surasā.
terms.hi: तुलसी (सुरसा) - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; कास-श्वासहर, कृमिघ्न, ज्वरघ्न; कफ-वातशामक।
terms.modern: Ocimum tenuiflorum L. (syn. O. sanctum L.), Lamiaceae.

terms.en: Medhya herb used for memory, intellect, anxiety and epilepsy; tikta-kaṣāya, śīta. Its identity is debated: Bacopa monnieri is the official brāhmī in most of India, while some traditions apply the name to Centella asiatica (maṇḍūkaparṇī).
terms.hi: ब्राह्मी - मेध्य; स्मृति, बुद्धि, अपस्मार, उन्माद में; पहचान पर मतभेद (बकोपा बनाम मण्डूकपर्णी)।
terms.modern: Bacopa monnieri (L.) Pennell, Plantaginaceae (official Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia source); Centella asiatica in some regions.

terms.en: 'Frog-leaf'; its juice is the first of Caraka's four medhya rasāyanas; also used for skin disease and wound healing.
terms.hi: मण्डूकपर्णी - मेंढक-पत्र जैसी; इसका स्वरस चरक का प्रथम मेध्य रसायन।
terms.modern: Centella asiatica (L.) Urb., Apiaceae.

terms.en: 'Conch-flowered'; medhya rasāyana (Caraka uses its paste), also used for insomnia and anxiety. Several plants are sold under this name.
terms.hi: शङ्खपुष्पी - शंख जैसे फूल वाली; मेध्य रसायन; पहचान पर मतभेद।
terms.modern: Convolvulus pluricaulis Choisy (official source); Evolvulus alsinoides and Clitoria ternatea are also used as śaṅkhapuṣpī regionally.

terms.en: 'Sweet stick'; madhura, guru, snigdha, śīta, madhura vipāka; kaṇṭhya, varṇya, vraṇaropaṇa, medhya (powder with milk is a medhya rasāyana), pacifies vāta and pitta. Also called madhuka.
terms.hi: यष्टिमधु (मुलेठी, मधुक) - मधुर, शीत; कण्ठ्य, वर्ण्य, व्रणरोपण, मेध्य; वात-पित्तशामक।
terms.modern: Glycyrrhiza glabra L., Fabaceae (root/stolon); excess use can raise blood pressure (glycyrrhizin).

terms.en: Bark drug; kaṣāya, śīta; hṛdya (cardiotonic), bhagna-sandhānakara (fracture-healing), used in raktapitta, prameha and wounds. Also called kakubha.
terms.hi: अर्जुन (ककुभ) - छाल; कषाय, शीत; हृद्य, भग्नसन्धानकर, रक्तपित्त, प्रमेह में।
terms.modern: Terminalia arjuna (Roxb. ex DC.) Wight & Arn., Combretaceae (bark).

terms.en: 'That which renews again' (the plant revives each rainy season); uṣṇa; śothaghna (anti-oedema), mūtrala, rasāyana; used in śotha, pāṇḍu and udara.
terms.hi: पुनर्नवा - 'पुनः नई होने वाली'; उष्ण; शोथघ्न, मूत्रल, रसायन; शोथ, पाण्डु, उदर में।
terms.modern: Boerhavia diffusa L., Nyctaginaceae (whole plant/root).

terms.en: Spiny fruit (śvadaṃṣṭrā); madhura, śīta, madhura vipāka; mūtrala, aśmarībhedana, vṛṣya, used in mūtrakṛcchra and aśmarī. A member of laghu pañcamūla.
terms.hi: गोक्षुर (गोखरू, श्वदंष्ट्रा) - मधुर, शीत; मूत्रल, अश्मरीभेदन, वृष्य; लघु पञ्चमूल का अंग।
terms.modern: Tribulus terrestris L., Zygophyllaceae (fruit).

terms.en: Herb named 'strength'; madhura, snigdha, śīta; balya, vātahara, used in vātavyādhi and debility (e.g. balā taila). Not to be confused with bala (strength) or bāla (child).
terms.hi: बला - मधुर, स्निग्ध, शीत; बल्य, वातहर; वातव्याधि में (बला तैल)।
terms.modern: Sida cordifolia L., Malvaceae (root).

terms.en: Bark is tikta-kaṣāya, śīta; Caraka names it the best drug for checking diarrhoea and drying kapha, pitta and blood; seeds are indrayava.
terms.hi: कुटज - छाल तिक्त-कषाय, शीत; अतिसार में श्रेष्ठ (चरक अग्र्य); बीज इन्द्रयव।
terms.modern: Holarrhena pubescens Wall. ex G.Don (syn. H. antidysenterica), Apocynaceae (bark).

terms.en: Unripe fruit is dīpana, pācana and grāhī (for diarrhoea and grahaṇī); root is a member of bṛhat pañcamūla (daśamūla).
terms.hi: बिल्व (बेल) - कच्चा फल दीपन, पाचन, ग्राही (अतिसार, ग्रहणी); मूल बृहत् पञ्चमूल में।
terms.modern: Aegle marmelos (L.) Corrêa, Rutaceae.

terms.en: Rhizome; kaṭu-tikta, tīkṣṇa, uṣṇa; medhya, lekhana, vāmaka in larger dose, used in speech, memory and epilepsy disorders. Named for promoting speech (vāc).
terms.hi: वचा (बच) - कटु-तिक्त, तीक्ष्ण, उष्ण; मेध्य, लेखन, अधिक मात्रा में वामक; वाणी और स्मृति हेतु।
terms.modern: Acorus calamus L., Acoraceae (rhizome); contains β-asarone, a toxicity concern with long-term use.

terms.en: Hairy rhizome; tikta-kaṣāya, śīta; medhya, nidrājanana, saṃjñāsthāpana (restores consciousness), used in insomnia, anxiety and unmāda.
terms.hi: जटामांसी - तिक्त-कषाय, शीत; मेध्य, निद्राजनक, संज्ञास्थापन।
terms.modern: Nardostachys jatamansi (D.Don) DC., Caprifoliaceae (rhizome); a threatened Himalayan species.

terms.en: Root; tikta, uṣṇa; nidrājanana and used in unmāda and high blood pressure; traditionally also used for snakebite.
terms.hi: सर्पगन्धा - तिक्त, उष्ण; निद्राजनक, उन्माद व उच्च रक्तचाप में।
terms.modern: Rauvolfia serpentina (L.) Benth. ex Kurz, Apocynaceae (root); source of reserpine.

terms.en: Root; kaṭu, tīkṣṇa, uṣṇa; Caraka's best drug for dīpana-pācana and for gudaśotha, arśas and śūla; strongly irritant (used after śodhana).
terms.hi: चित्रक - कटु, तीक्ष्ण, उष्ण; दीपन-पाचन में श्रेष्ठ, अर्श, शूल में।
terms.modern: Plumbago zeylanica L., Plumbaginaceae (root); contains plumbagin.

terms.en: Leaf pulp; tikta-madhura, picchila, śīta; bhedana, used in liver and menstrual disorders and burns; dried leaf exudate is kumārīsāra.
terms.hi: कुमारी (घृतकुमारी, ग्वारपाठा) - तिक्त-मधुर, पिच्छिल, शीत; भेदन, यकृत व आर्तव विकारों में।
terms.modern: Aloe vera (L.) Burm.f. (syn. A. barbadensis Mill.), Asphodelaceae.

terms.en: Oleo-gum resin; laghu, viśada, sūkṣma, uṣṇa; lekhana and vātahara. Caraka names it the best for medas and vāta; fresh guggulu is bṛṃhaṇa while old guggulu is lekhana. Base of guggulu kalpanās (e.g. yogarāja guggulu).
terms.hi: गुग्गुलु - गोंद-राल; लघु, विशद, सूक्ष्म, उष्ण; लेखन, वातहर; मेद व वात में श्रेष्ठ; नया बृंहण, पुराना लेखन।
terms.modern: Commiphora wightii (Arn.) Bhandari (syn. C. mukul), Burseraceae (oleo-gum resin).

terms.en: Tuber; tikta-kaṭu-kaṣāya, śīta; Caraka's best for sāṅgrāhika (binding), dīpana and pācana; also jvaraghna and tṛṣṇānigrahaṇa.
terms.hi: मुस्ता (मोथा) - तिक्त-कटु-कषाय, शीत; ग्राही, दीपन, पाचन में श्रेष्ठ; ज्वरघ्न।
terms.modern: Cyperus rotundus L., Cyperaceae (tuber).

terms.en: Whole plant; intensely tikta, śīta; jvaraghna, used in fevers, skin disease and liver disorders.
terms.hi: किराततिक्त (चिरायता) - अति तिक्त, शीत; ज्वरघ्न, त्वचा व यकृत विकारों में।
terms.modern: Swertia chirayita (Roxb.) H.Karst., Gentianaceae.

terms.en: Rhizome; tikta, śīta; bhedana (Śārṅgadhara's example), dīpana, used in jvara, kāmalā and liver disorders.
terms.hi: कटुकी (कुटकी) - तिक्त, शीत; भेदन, दीपन; ज्वर, कामला, यकृत विकार में।
terms.modern: Picrorhiza kurroa Royle ex Benth., Plantaginaceae (rhizome).

terms.en: Marking-nut fruit; uṣṇa, tīkṣṇa; arśoghna, rasāyana and used in kuṣṭha and vāta-kapha disorders. Must undergo śodhana; its juice causes severe contact dermatitis.
terms.hi: भल्लातक (भिलावा) - उष्ण, तीक्ष्ण; अर्शोघ्न, रसायन; शोधन आवश्यक; त्वचा पर फफोले करता है।
terms.modern: Semecarpus anacardium L.f., Anacardiaceae (fruit).

terms.en: Root: madhura, uṣṇa; Caraka's best for vṛṣya (virility) and vātahara. Seed oil (eraṇḍa taila) is a virecana drug, esteemed for āmavāta and in sukha-virecana.
terms.hi: एरण्ड (अरण्डी) - मूल मधुर, उष्ण; वृष्य, वातहर में श्रेष्ठ; तैल विरेचक, आमवात में।
terms.modern: Ricinus communis L., Euphorbiaceae; seeds contain the toxin ricin (removed in oil).

terms.en: Root; the best drug for comfortable purgation (sukha-virecana) per Caraka and the chief virecana drug in AH.kalpa.1.1; Śārṅgadhara's example of recana.
terms.hi: त्रिवृत् (निशोथ) - मूल; सुखविरेचन में श्रेष्ठ; रेचन का उदाहरण।
terms.modern: Operculina turpethum (L.) Silva Manso (syn. Ipomoea turpethum), Convolvulaceae (root).

terms.en: Purgative root; Vāgbhaṭa's example of prabhāva: similar to citraka in rasa etc., yet dantī purges.
terms.hi: दन्ती - विरेचक मूल; प्रभाव का उदाहरण (चित्रक के समान होकर भी विरेचक)।
terms.modern: Baliospermum montanum (Willd.) Müll.Arg., Euphorbiaceae (root).

terms.en: Fruit; the best emetic drug (vamana-śreṣṭha) per Vāgbhaṭa and Caraka; Śārṅgadhara's example of vāmaka.
terms.hi: मदनफल (मैनफल) - वमन हेतु श्रेष्ठ द्रव्य।
terms.modern: Catunaregam spinosa (Thunb.) Tirveng. (syn. Randia dumetorum), Rubiaceae (fruit).

terms.en: Leaf; tikta-kaṣāya, śīta; the leading drug for raktapitta and also for kāsa and śvāsa.
terms.hi: वासा (अडूसा) - तिक्त-कषाय, शीत; रक्तपित्त, कास, श्वास में श्रेष्ठ।
terms.modern: Justicia adhatoda L. (syn. Adhatoda vasica Nees), Acanthaceae (leaf); contains vasicine.

terms.en: Root; madhura-tikta-kaṣāya, uṣṇa; varṇya, viṣaghna, rakta-prasādana, used in kuṣṭha and wounds.
terms.hi: मञ्जिष्ठा - मधुर-तिक्त-कषाय, उष्ण; वर्ण्य, रक्तप्रसादन, विषघ्न, कुष्ठ में।
terms.modern: Rubia cordifolia L., Rubiaceae (root).

terms.en: Root; madhura-tikta, śīta; rakta-śodhaka, dāha-praśamana, jvarahara, used in skin disease and burning sensation.
terms.hi: सारिवा (अनन्तमूल) - मधुर-तिक्त, शीत; रक्तशोधक, दाहप्रशमन, ज्वरहर।
terms.modern: Hemidesmus indicus (L.) R.Br., Apocynaceae (root).

terms.en: Heartwood (śveta candana); tikta-madhura, śīta; dāha-praśamana, varṇya, tṛṣṇāhara, used in pitta disorders.
terms.hi: चन्दन (श्वेत) - तिक्त-मधुर, शीत; दाहप्रशमन, वर्ण्य, पित्तशामक।
terms.modern: Santalum album L., Santalaceae (heartwood).

terms.en: Root; tikta-madhura, śīta; dāha-praśamana, tṛṣṇā-nigrahaṇa, sveda-reducing; used in pānīya (medicated drinking water).
terms.hi: उशीर (खस) - तिक्त-मधुर, शीत; दाहशामक, तृष्णानिग्रहण।
terms.modern: Chrysopogon zizanioides (L.) Roberty (syn. Vetiveria zizanioides), Poaceae (root).

terms.en: Bark; kaṣāya, śīta; grāhī, cakṣuṣya, śoṇitasthāpana; used in pradara and other yoni disorders.
terms.hi: लोध्र - कषाय, शीत; ग्राही, चक्षुष्य, रक्तस्तम्भक; प्रदर में।
terms.modern: Symplocos racemosa Roxb., Symplocaceae (bark).

terms.en: Bark; kaṣāya-tikta, śīta; used in excessive uterine bleeding (asṛgdara) and other gynaecological disorders. Name means 'without sorrow'.
terms.hi: अशोक - छाल; कषाय-तिक्त, शीत; असृग्दर (प्रदर) में प्रसिद्ध।
terms.modern: Saraca asoca (Roxb.) Willd., Fabaceae (bark); commonly adulterated with Polyalthia longifolia.

terms.en: Heartwood; tikta-kaṣāya, śīta; Caraka's best drug for kuṣṭha; also used for dental and oral health (catechu).
terms.hi: खदिर (कत्था) - तिक्त-कषाय, शीत; कुष्ठघ्न में श्रेष्ठ; दन्त-मुख रोगों में।
terms.modern: Senegalia catechu (L.f.) P.J.H.Hurter & Mabb. (syn. Acacia catechu (L.f.) Willd.), Fabaceae.

terms.en: Seed oil, bark and leaves; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; kuṣṭhaghna, krimighna, vraṇaśodhana; twigs used as tooth-brush.
terms.hi: करञ्ज - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; कुष्ठघ्न, कृमिघ्न, व्रणशोधन; दातुन हेतु।
terms.modern: Pongamia pinnata (L.) Pierre (syn. Millettia pinnata), Fabaceae.

terms.en: Fruit; kaṭu, uṣṇa; Caraka's best anthelmintic (krimighna); also dīpana.
terms.hi: विडङ्ग (वायविडंग) - कटु, उष्ण; कृमिघ्न में श्रेष्ठ।
terms.modern: Embelia ribes Burm.f., Primulaceae (fruit).

terms.en: Oleo-gum resin; kaṭu, tīkṣṇa, uṣṇa; Caraka's best for chedana, dīpana, vātānulomana and relieving vāta-kapha; used for colic and flatulence (after frying/śodhana).
terms.hi: हिङ्गु (हींग) - कटु, तीक्ष्ण, उष्ण; छेदन, दीपन, वातानुलोमन में श्रेष्ठ; उदरशूल में।
terms.modern: Ferula assa-foetida L., Apiaceae (oleo-gum resin).

terms.en: Seed; kaṭu, uṣṇa; dīpana, pācana, grāhī; used in indigestion, diarrhoea and grahaṇī.
terms.hi: जीरक (जीरा) - कटु, उष्ण; दीपन, पाचन, ग्राही।
terms.modern: Cuminum cyminum L., Apiaceae (fruit).

terms.en: Fruit; dīpana, pācana, tṛṣṇā- and dāha-reducing, mūtrala; Bhāvaprakāśa calls it uṣṇa while fresh leaves are regarded as cooling.
terms.hi: धान्यक (धनिया) - दीपन, पाचन, तृष्णा-दाहशामक, मूत्रल।
terms.modern: Coriandrum sativum L., Apiaceae (fruit).

terms.en: Small cardamom (sūkṣmailā); kaṭu-madhura, śīta; rocana, chardinigrahaṇa, mukhaśodhana; one of trijātaka.
terms.hi: एला (छोटी इलायची) - कटु-मधुर, शीत; रोचन, छर्दिनिग्रहण; त्रिजातक का अंग।
terms.modern: Elettaria cardamomum (L.) Maton, Zingiberaceae (seed).

terms.en: Flower bud; tikta-kaṭu, laghu; rocana, dīpana, used in cough, hiccup, toothache and vomiting.
terms.hi: लवङ्ग (लौंग) - तिक्त-कटु, लघु; रोचन, दीपन; कास, हिक्का, दन्तशूल में।
terms.modern: Syzygium aromaticum (L.) Merr. & L.M.Perry, Myrtaceae (flower bud); contains eugenol.

terms.en: Bark; kaṭu-tikta-madhura, uṣṇa; dīpana, kapha-vātahara, mukhaśodhana; one of trijātaka. Also the word for skin (see tvak-skin).
terms.hi: त्वक् (दालचीनी) - कटु-मधुर, उष्ण; दीपन, कफ-वातहर; त्रिजातक का अंग। (त्वक् = त्वचा भी)
terms.modern: Cinnamomum verum J.Presl (syn. C. zeylanicum Blume), Lauraceae (bark).

terms.en: Group of three aromatics: tvak (cinnamon), elā (cardamom) and tejapatra (Indian bay leaf); adding nāgakeśara makes caturjātaka.
terms.hi: त्रिजातक - त्वक्, एला, तेजपत्र; नागकेशर मिलाने पर चातुर्जातक।

terms.en: Stamens/flowers; kaṣāya-tikta; pācana (Śārṅgadhara's example), used in bleeding piles and raktapitta; member of caturjātaka.
terms.hi: नागकेशर - कषाय-तिक्त; पाचन का उदाहरण; रक्तार्श और रक्तपित्त में।
terms.modern: Mesua ferrea L., Calophyllaceae (stamens); market samples vary.

terms.en: The 'ten roots': bṛhat pañcamūla (bilva, agnimantha, śyonāka, pāṭalā, gambhārī) plus laghu pañcamūla (śālaparṇī, pṛśniparṇī, bṛhatī, kaṇṭakārī, gokṣura). Tridoṣahara, especially vātahara, śothahara; used in daśamūla kvātha and ariṣṭa.
terms.hi: दशमूल - बृहत् पञ्चमूल (बिल्व, अग्निमन्थ, श्योनाक, पाटला, गम्भारी) + लघु पञ्चमूल (शालपर्णी, पृश्निपर्णी, बृहती, कण्टकारी, गोक्षुर); वातहर, शोथहर।

terms.en: Roots of five trees: bilva, agnimantha, śyonāka, pāṭalā and gambhārī; uṣṇa, kapha-vātahara.
terms.hi: बृहत् पञ्चमूल - पाँच वृक्षों की जड़: बिल्व, अग्निमन्थ, श्योनाक, पाटला, गम्भारी।

terms.en: Roots of five small plants: śālaparṇī, pṛśniparṇī, bṛhatī, kaṇṭakārī and gokṣura; vāta-pittahara, bṛṃhaṇa.
terms.hi: लघु पञ्चमूल - शालपर्णी, पृश्निपर्णी, बृहती, कण्टकारी, गोक्षुर।

terms.en: Member of bṛhat pañcamūla; uṣṇa, śothahara, vāta-kaphahara; its wood was used to kindle fire by friction, hence the name.
terms.hi: अग्निमन्थ (अरणी) - बृहत् पञ्चमूल का अंग; उष्ण, शोथहर।
terms.modern: Premna integrifolia L. (syn. P. serratifolia L.), Lamiaceae; Clerodendrum phlomidis is used in some regions (identity debated).

terms.en: Member of bṛhat pañcamūla; root bark is grāhī/stambhana and vātahara.
terms.hi: श्योनाक (सोनापाठा) - बृहत् पञ्चमूल का अंग; ग्राही, वातहर।
terms.modern: Oroxylum indicum (L.) Kurz, Bignoniaceae (root bark).

terms.en: Member of bṛhat pañcamūla; tridoṣahara, śothahara.
terms.hi: पाटला - बृहत् पञ्चमूल का अंग; शोथहर।
terms.modern: Stereospermum suaveolens (Roxb.) DC. (syn. S. chelonoides), Bignoniaceae.

terms.en: Member of bṛhat pañcamūla (also kāśmarya); fruit is madhura and bṛṃhaṇa.
terms.hi: गम्भारी (काश्मर्य) - बृहत् पञ्चमूल का अंग।
terms.modern: Gmelina arborea Roxb., Lamiaceae.

terms.en: Member of laghu pañcamūla; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; kāsa-śvāsahara.
terms.hi: बृहती - लघु पञ्चमूल का अंग; कास-श्वासहर।
terms.modern: Solanum indicum L. (syn. S. anguivi Lam.), Solanaceae.

terms.en: Thorny member of laghu pañcamūla; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; kāsahara (Caraka's list), śvāsahara; used in kaṇṭakārī avaleha/ghṛta.
terms.hi: कण्टकारी (भटकटैया) - लघु पञ्चमूल का अंग; कासहर, श्वासहर।
terms.modern: Solanum virginianum L. (syn. S. xanthocarpum Schrad. & H.Wendl., S. surattense), Solanaceae.

terms.en: Member of laghu pañcamūla; madhura, guru; tridoṣahara, bṛṃhaṇa, vṛṣya.
terms.hi: शालपर्णी - लघु पञ्चमूल का अंग; बृंहण, त्रिदोषहर।
terms.modern: Desmodium gangeticum (L.) DC., Fabaceae.

terms.en: Member of laghu pañcamūla; tridoṣahara, sandhānīya.
terms.hi: पृश्निपर्णी - लघु पञ्चमूल का अंग; सन्धानीय।
terms.modern: Uraria picta (Jacq.) Desv. ex DC., Fabaceae.

terms.en: Group of five pungent dīpana-pācana drugs: pippalī, pippalīmūla, cavya, citraka and śuṇṭhī.
terms.hi: पञ्चकोल - पिप्पली, पिप्पलीमूल, चव्य, चित्रक, शुण्ठी; दीपन-पाचन।

terms.en: Group of eight rare Himalayan rejuvenating herbs: jīvaka, ṛṣabhaka, medā, mahāmedā, kākolī, kṣīrakākolī, ṛddhi and vṛddhi. Owing to scarcity and uncertain identity, substitutes (pratinidhi) are permitted (e.g. in Bhāvaprakāśa).
terms.hi: अष्टवर्ग - आठ दुर्लभ हिमालयी रसायन द्रव्य: जीवक, ऋषभक, मेदा, महामेदा, काकोली, क्षीरकाकोली, ऋद्धि, वृद्धि; अभाव में प्रतिनिधि द्रव्य।
terms.modern: Mostly orchids and lilies (e.g. Malaxis, Polygonatum, Habenaria species); identity is debated.

terms.en: Substitute drug permitted when the original is unavailable, chosen for similar properties (e.g. aśvagandhā for medā/mahāmedā in some texts).
terms.hi: प्रतिनिधि द्रव्य - मूल द्रव्य न मिलने पर समान गुण वाला विकल्प।
terms.modern: Comparable to approved substitutes; distinct from adulteration.

terms.en: Seed and seed oil; uṣṇa, tīkṣṇa; medhya, used for memory and vāta disorders; also used for its sweat-inducing property.
terms.hi: ज्योतिष्मती (मालकांगनी) - उष्ण, तीक्ष्ण; मेध्य।
terms.modern: Celastrus paniculatus Willd., Celastraceae (seed).

terms.en: Seed; madhura, guru, snigdha; vājīkaraṇa, balya; pod hairs cause intense itching (hence 'monkey itch'); used in kampavāta.
terms.hi: कपिकच्छु (कौंच) - बीज; मधुर, गुरु; वाजीकरण, बल्य; फली के रोम खुजली करते हैं।
terms.modern: Mucuna pruriens (L.) DC., Fabaceae (seed); contains L-DOPA, studied in Parkinson's disease.

terms.en: Tuber (vidārīkanda); madhura, śīta; balya, stanyajanana, vṛṣya, bṛṃhaṇa.
terms.hi: विदारी (विदारीकन्द) - मधुर, शीत; बल्य, स्तन्यजनन, वृष्य।
terms.modern: Pueraria tuberosa (Willd.) DC., Fabaceae (tuber); Ipomoea mauritiana is also traded as vidārī (identity debated).

terms.en: Root; tikta-kaṭu, uṣṇa; dīpana, pācana, grāhī; widely used in children's diarrhoea, fever and cough. Unlike its relative vatsanābha it is non-toxic, despite the name.
terms.hi: अतिविषा (अतीस) - तिक्त-कटु, उष्ण; दीपन, पाचन, ग्राही; बालरोगों में प्रसिद्ध; विषैली नहीं।
terms.modern: Aconitum heterophyllum Wall. ex Royle, Ranunculaceae (root).

terms.en: Root; tikta, uṣṇa; grāhī, stanyaśodhana, jvaraghna; identity debated.
terms.hi: पाठा - तिक्त, उष्ण; ग्राही, स्तन्यशोधन, ज्वरघ्न।
terms.modern: Cissampelos pareira L., Menispermaceae (commonly accepted); Cyclea peltata used in South India.

terms.en: Caraka's best vātahara drug (agrya); used in vātavyādhi and āmavāta (e.g. rāsnā-saptaka kvātha). Identity varies regionally.
terms.hi: रास्ना - वातहर में श्रेष्ठ; वातव्याधि, आमवात में।
terms.modern: Pluchea lanceolata (DC.) C.B.Clarke (Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia); Alpinia galanga and Vanda roxburghii are used regionally.

terms.en: 'Timber of the gods'; heartwood; tikta, uṣṇa; kapha-vātahara, śothahara, used in vāta disorders and skin disease.
terms.hi: देवदारु - तिक्त, उष्ण; कफ-वातहर, शोथहर।
terms.modern: Cedrus deodara (Roxb. ex D.Don) G.Don, Pinaceae.

terms.en: Leaf; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; vātahara, śothahara, vedanāsthāpana; leaves used for fomentation (patra-piṇḍa sveda) and oil in joint pain.
terms.hi: निर्गुण्डी - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; वातहर, शोथहर, वेदनाशामक; पत्र पिण्ड स्वेद में।
terms.modern: Vitex negundo L., Lamiaceae (leaf).

terms.en: Root bark, leaves and seeds; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; śothahara, krimighna, cakṣuṣya, used in vāta-kapha disorders.
terms.hi: शिग्रु (सहजन) - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; शोथहर, कृमिघ्न।
terms.modern: Moringa oleifera Lam., Moringaceae.

terms.en: Oleo-gum resin of the śallakī tree; kaṣāya-tikta; used in joint pain, inflammation and skin disease.
terms.hi: शल्लकी (सलई गुग्गुल) - कषाय-तिक्त; सन्धिशूल व शोथ में।
terms.modern: Boswellia serrata Roxb. ex Colebr., Burseraceae (gum resin); boswellic acids are studied for osteoarthritis.

terms.en: Milky-latex shrub with two varieties (rakta and śveta); uṣṇa, tīkṣṇa; latex is an upaviṣa; used externally and in kṣāra preparation. Not to be confused with arka kalpanā (distillate).
terms.hi: अर्क (आक, मदार) - दो प्रकार; उष्ण, तीक्ष्ण; दूध उपविष; बाह्य प्रयोग। (अर्क कल्पना से भिन्न)
terms.modern: Calotropis procera (Aiton) Dryand. and C. gigantea (L.) Dryand., Apocynaceae.

terms.en: Latex plant; tīkṣṇa virecana (latex is an upaviṣa and the strongest purgative); latex is used in coating kṣārasūtra.
terms.hi: स्नुही (थूहर) - दूध तीक्ष्ण विरेचक, उपविष; क्षारसूत्र बनाने में।
terms.modern: Euphorbia neriifolia L., Euphorbiaceae (latex).

terms.en: Seeds and leaves; an upaviṣa; madakārī, used after śodhana in śvāsa (as smoking) and painful conditions.
terms.hi: धत्तूर (धतूरा) - उपविष; मदकारी; शोधन के बाद श्वास आदि में।
terms.modern: Datura metel L., Solanaceae; contains tropane alkaloids (hyoscine, atropine), highly toxic.

terms.en: Tuberous root; a highly toxic mahāviṣa (sthāvara viṣa) used only after śodhana (usually in cow's urine) in tiny doses, e.g. in tribhuvanakīrti rasa.
terms.hi: वत्सनाभ (बछनाग) - अति विषैली जड़; केवल शोधन के बाद अल्प मात्रा में।
terms.modern: Aconitum ferox Wall. ex Ser., Ranunculaceae (root); contains aconitine, a cardiotoxin.

terms.en: Seed; an upaviṣa used after śodhana in vāta disorders and as a tonic.
terms.hi: कुपीलु (कुचला) - बीज; उपविष; शोधन के बाद वातव्याधि में।
terms.modern: Strychnos nux-vomica L., Loganiaceae (seed); contains strychnine.

terms.en: Seed; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; grāhī, dīpana, nidrājanana, vājīkaraṇa in small doses; toxic in large doses.
terms.hi: जातीफल (जायफल) - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; ग्राही, निद्राजनक; अधिक मात्रा विषैली।
terms.modern: Myristica fragrans Houtt., Myristicaceae (seed).

terms.en: Seeds are krimighna; flowers, bark and kṣāra are used (palāśa kṣāra).
terms.hi: पलाश (ढाक) - बीज कृमिघ्न; पुष्प, छाल, क्षार का प्रयोग।
terms.modern: Butea monosperma (Lam.) Taub., Fabaceae.

terms.en: Whole plant; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; used in kṣāra preparation (apāmārga kṣāra, also for kṣārasūtra), śirovirecana, and as a tooth-brush.
terms.hi: अपामार्ग (चिरचिटा) - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; क्षार बनाने में, शिरोविरेचन में।
terms.modern: Achyranthes aspera L., Amaranthaceae.

terms.en: 'King of hair'; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; keśya (hair tonic), rasāyana, used in liver disorders and greying.
terms.hi: भृङ्गराज (भांगरा) - केश्य, रसायन; यकृत विकार और पलित में।
terms.modern: Eclipta prostrata (L.) L. (syn. E. alba (L.) Hassk.), Asteraceae.

terms.en: Grass; madhura-tikta-kaṣāya, śīta; śoṇitasthāpana (stops bleeding), dāhapraśamana; white variety (śatavīryā/sahasravīryā) in prajāsthāpana group.
terms.hi: दूर्वा (दूब) - शीत; रक्तस्तम्भक, दाहशामक; प्रजास्थापन वर्ग में।
terms.modern: Cynodon dactylon (L.) Pers., Poaceae.

terms.en: Bulb with five rasas (all except amla), kaṭu predominant; uṣṇa, tīkṣṇa; vātahara, rasāyana, used in vāta disorders, heart disease and worms. Also called rasona.
terms.hi: लशुन (लहसुन, रसोन) - अम्ल छोड़ पाँच रस, कटु प्रधान; उष्ण, तीक्ष्ण; वातहर, रसायन।
terms.modern: Allium sativum L., Amaryllidaceae (bulb).

terms.en: Root; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; Caraka's best for hikkā, śvāsa, kāsa and pārśvaśūla.
terms.hi: पुष्करमूल - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; हिक्का, श्वास, कास, पार्श्वशूल में श्रेष्ठ।
terms.modern: Inula racemosa Hook.f., Asteraceae (root).

terms.en: Bark; kaṣāya, śīta; used in gaṇḍamālā, galagaṇḍa and granthi (kāñcanāra guggulu).
terms.hi: काञ्चनार (कचनार) - छाल; कषाय, शीत; गण्डमाला, गलगण्ड, ग्रन्थि में।
terms.modern: Bauhinia variegata L., Fabaceae (bark).

terms.en: Bark; tikta-kaṣāya, uṣṇa; aśmarībhedana, mūtrala; used for urinary stones.
terms.hi: वरुण - छाल; अश्मरीभेदन, मूत्रल।
terms.modern: Crateva nurvala Buch.-Ham. (syn. C. magna (Lour.) DC.), Capparaceae (bark).

terms.en: 'Stone-breaker'; mūtrala, aśmarībhedana; in Caraka's mūtravirecanīya group. Several plants are used under this name.
terms.hi: पाषाणभेद - 'पत्थर तोड़ने वाला'; अश्मरीभेदन, मूत्रल।
terms.modern: Bergenia ciliata (Haw.) Sternb., Saxifragaceae (commonly accepted); identity debated.

terms.en: Fruit; sweet variety is tridoṣahara, sour variety pacifies vāta-kapha; hṛdya, grāhī; rind used in diarrhoea.
terms.hi: दाडिम (अनार) - मधुर प्रकार त्रिदोषहर; हृद्य, ग्राही।
terms.modern: Punica granatum L., Lythraceae.

terms.en: Fruit (mṛdvīkā); madhura, śīta, snigdha; jvarahara, kāsahara, used in tṛṣṇā, dāha and raktapitta; basis of drākṣāriṣṭa/drākṣāsava.
terms.hi: द्राक्षा (मुनक्का, मृद्वीका) - मधुर, शीत; ज्वरहर, कासहर, तृष्णा व दाह में।
terms.modern: Vitis vinifera L., Vitaceae (dried fruit).

terms.en: Aromatic root; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; vāta-kaphahara, used in kāsa, śvāsa and skin conditions. Not to be confused with kuṣṭha the disease.
terms.hi: कुष्ठ (कूठ) - सुगन्धित मूल; कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; वात-कफहर। (कुष्ठ रोग से भिन्न)
terms.modern: Saussurea costus (Falc.) Lipsch. (syn. S. lappa), Asteraceae (root); CITES-listed.

terms.en: Silk-cotton tree; its gum (mocarasa) is grāhī and śoṇitasthāpana.
terms.hi: शाल्मली (सेमल) - गोंद मोचरस ग्राही व रक्तस्तम्भक।
terms.modern: Bombax ceiba L., Malvaceae.

terms.en: Flowers; kaṣāya, śīta; grāhī; also the classical fermentation starter in āsava-ariṣṭa preparation.
terms.hi: धातकी (धाय) - पुष्प कषाय, शीत, ग्राही; आसव-अरिष्ट में किण्वन हेतु।
terms.modern: Woodfordia fruticosa (L.) Kurz, Lythraceae (flower).

terms.en: Seed; kaṭu-tikta, uṣṇa; kuṣṭhaghna, especially used in śvitra (vitiligo).
terms.hi: बाकुची (बावची) - कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण; श्वित्र में प्रसिद्ध।
terms.modern: Psoralea corylifolia L. (syn. Cullen corylifolium), Fabaceae (seed); contains psoralens (photosensitising).

terms.en: Fruit pulp; madhura, śīta; mild laxative (Śārṅgadhara's example of sraṃsana), kuṣṭhaghna, jvaraghna; safe for children and the weak.
terms.hi: आरग्वध (अमलतास) - फल-मज्जा मधुर, शीत; स्रंसन, कुष्ठघ्न।
terms.modern: Cassia fistula L., Fabaceae (fruit pulp).

terms.en: Bark; Caraka's best antidote (viṣaghna); also used in allergic and skin conditions.
terms.hi: शिरीष - विषघ्न में श्रेष्ठ; त्वचा विकारों में।
terms.modern: Albizia lebbeck (L.) Benth., Fabaceae (bark).

terms.en: Seed; madhura-tikta-kaṣāya-kaṭu, uṣṇa, snigdha; its oil (tila taila) is the best of oils for abhyaṅga and taila-pāka.
terms.hi: तिल - उष्ण, स्निग्ध; तिल तैल सबसे श्रेष्ठ तैल।
terms.modern: Sesamum indicum L., Pedaliaceae (seed).

terms.en: Fruit; kaṭu, uṣṇa; dīpana, śūlapraśamana; in Caraka's śūlapraśamana group.
terms.hi: अजमोदा - कटु, उष्ण; दीपन, शूलप्रशमन।
terms.modern: Trachyspermum roxburghianum (DC.) H.Wolff (commonly accepted); Apium graveolens in some texts.

terms.en: Intensely bitter herb used in fever and liver disorders. It is not described in the Bṛhattrayī; it enters later and folk practice (often called bhūnimba).
terms.hi: कालमेघ (भूनिम्ब) - अति तिक्त; ज्वर व यकृत विकार में; बृहत्त्रयी में वर्णित नहीं।
terms.modern: Andrographis paniculata (Burm.f.) Nees, Acanthaceae.

terms.en: 'Foremost': Caraka's list (CS.sutra.25) of the single best drug, food or practice for each purpose, e.g. kuṭaja for diarrhoea, citraka for dīpana, rāsnā for vāta, āmalakī for vayaḥsthāpana.
terms.hi: अग्र्य - सर्वश्रेष्ठ; चरक सूत्र 25 में प्रत्येक कार्य हेतु सर्वश्रेष्ठ द्रव्य/आचरण की सूची।
